title: Cibus Credentials
description: Your Cibus credentials are essential for WoltFlow to access your meal benefits and automatically purchase Wolt gift cards on your behalf. These credentials are input in your settings and used by the automation to log into your Cibus account during each run.

whatIsCibus.title: What is Cibus?
whatIsCibus.description: Cibus is a popular meal benefits platform used by many companies to provide food allowances to their employees. WoltFlow connects to your Cibus account to automatically convert your meal benefits into Wolt gift cards, streamlining your food ordering experience.

whatWoltFlowDoes.title: What WoltFlow Does
features: Logs into your Cibus account securely
Purchases Wolt gift cards using your meal benefits
Operates within your benefit allowance limits

securityPrivacy.title: Security & Privacy
features: All credentials are encrypted at rest
No credential sharing or third-party access
You can delete your data at any time

requiredCredentials.title: Required Credentials
requiredCredentials.description: To set up the Cibus integration, you'll need to provide three pieces of information that you use to log into your Cibus account:

username.title: Username/Email
username.description: The email address or username you use to log into your Cibus account. This is typically your work email address.

password.title: Password
password.description: Your Cibus account password. This will be encrypted and stored securely in our systems and never transmitted in plain text.
password.securityNote: We use industry-standard AES encryption to protect your password. Only the automation system can decrypt it during runs.

companyName.title: Company Name
companyName.description: Your company identifier in Cibus. This is usually your company's name as it appears in the Cibus system, used to direct the login to the correct company portal.
companyName.tipsLabel: How to find your company name:
tips: Log into your Cibus account normally
Check the URL or company branding on the login page
Look for the company identifier in your account settings

step1.title: Access WoltFlow Settings
step1.description: Navigate to your WoltFlow settings page where you can configure all your account credentials and automation preferences.

step2.title: Locate Cibus Credentials Section
step2.description: In the settings page, find the "Cibus Credentials" section. This is where you'll input your login information that the automation will use to access your Cibus account.

step3.title: Enter Your Credentials
step3.description: Fill in all three required fields with your Cibus login information. Make sure the information matches exactly what you use to log into Cibus manually.

step4.title: Save and Test
step4.description: Save your credentials and test the connection to ensure WoltFlow can successfully access your Cibus account. The system will verify your credentials during the next automation run.
step4.testDescription: The best way to test your Cibus credentials is to trigger a manual automation run after setting up all your credentials and forwarding configurations.

twoFactorAuth.title: Two-Factor Authentication (2FA)
twoFactorAuth.description: If your Cibus account has two-factor authentication enabled via SMS, WoltFlow can handle verification codes automatically through SMS forwarding. This ensures seamless automation even with enhanced security measures.

smsSupport.title: SMS 2FA Support
features: Works with all major SMS providers

setupRequirements.title: Setup Requirements
steps: Configure SMS forwarding in your settings
Ensure your phone number matches Cibus registration
Test the forwarding with a manual 2FA trigger
Verify automation can receive and process codes

seamlessIntegration.title: Seamless Integration
seamlessIntegration.description: Once SMS forwarding is configured, 2FA codes are processed completely automatically during automation runs. You don't need to manually enter codes or monitor the process - WoltFlow handles everything behind the scenes.

invalidCredentials.title: Login Failed - Invalid Credentials
solutions: Double-check your username, password, and company name
Try logging into Cibus manually to verify credentials
Ensure there are no extra spaces or typos

twoFACodes.title: 2FA Codes Not Being Processed
solutions: Verify SMS forwarding is configured correctly
Check that your phone number matches Cibus registration
Test SMS forwarding manually by triggering a 2FA code

companyNotFound.title: Company Not Found
solutions: Contact your HR department for the correct company identifier
Check the Cibus login page URL for company information
Try variations of your company name (with/without spaces, abbreviations)

conclusion.title: Credentials Setup Complete!
conclusion.description: Once your Cibus credentials are configured, you can continue with the remaining setup steps including SMS forwarding, email forwarding, and automation settings to complete your WoltFlow configuration.
